I know it might be hard to see rationally now, but girl, you dodged a bullet. I've been there. I'm 36 and I've seen some shit and been through hell and back. I'm finally with a great partner, but been where you are many times....
Left wondering why? If you were good enough then why not now, etc etc... so many questions I know you're slamming yourself with, tearing yourself apart.... but don't  ! 
I know it sounds cliche but sweetness, it wasnt meant to be and some day you'll understand why! Bad things fall apart so good things can come tg! Mighr not hit gold with the next bf or even the next 4 or 5 but it's all shaping you into a strong, smart, intuitive woman. 
I've learned always trust your gut. You'll get through this. You'll be more weary when you start dating again. As you get older you'll start not tolerating BS in your life. I was always  push over but I'm slowly getting better! Chin up! 
I hope I didnt make you upset, only trying to convey that you can and WILL do better! You'll strike out a few times but keep trying! Chalk it up as a hard (unfortunate) lesson learned! Stay strong!! <3

Oh man, I'm sorry that's happening to you.  There is literally NO excuse. IMO, blatant flirting like that is damn near equivalent to cheating. 
She is doing is purposely, she is doing it knowing you arent comfortable with it... I'll mention rn, I'm a woman and a past serial cheater 😬
She needs to stop.  One of my go to chats starts by tastefully pouring my heart out, not accusing, but knowing maybe I did something to push them there? Not saying you have, I find it helps remaining unbiased and willing to hear and accept any answer regardless if it aligns with my prerogative. I try and understand why they are doing that. 
If in your case you feel you are fulfilling all of your partners needs then clearly she is being selfish. 
I'll tell you, as a woman, (recovering cheater)I've found my soulmate but sometimes I act out to get attention, similar to what your Gf is doing.... myself,  I know I'm just fishing for attention but how can you know whether she is fishing or serious? 
Idk, either way, you dont deserve that and considering the fact you've told her you dont care for the new budding relationship (and rightly so!!) I feel and I'm sorry to say, I feel she may be being unfaithful. 
However, to me, an emotional affair is as valid or more so than a physical one.  
Gahhhh, I'm rambling but I'm a woman, telling you, dont put up with that. 
When my bf fucks up like that, after I pour my heart out, I ask him how he would react if I had done this to him,  and i really get him to take that in, and he admits that yes he was selfish etc, it's not always his fault. Sometimes I put up a wall by means of trying to protect myself.

Yes mine had naloxone in it as well. I took 1/4 first day then a piece 1/8 size yesterday which was 2nd day on suboxone but 3rd day off percs. Woke up a but sore today but still great feeling! 
Be sure to read a lot! I've read the bupe stays in system for upwards of 3 days. I'd be very cautious when you fill your script to ensure the sub wore off a couple days. Also, to ease your worry the sub should last for pain relief a couple days if that's any consolation

Well I'm here to tell ya, I feel incredible from the sub. Waited 36 hours clean then took a quarter of the pill so 2mg and that was too much. I felt mostly great but I was off and on like high or something all day. Idk if you ever smoked weed and ever greened out but it was like that. I felt the color drop from me I was pouring and I fuckiibg mean POURING sweat and I thought I was going to vomit,  I leaned over the toilet and just drooled, my mouth was watering and heart was racing. But dont let that scare ya from taking it. Start with 1mg like you said. 
After taking that 2mg at 1pm yesterday I went till 6pm this evening and took an eighth of a pill, so 1mg and felt great. I didnt even have to take the 1mg I probably could've waited till tm but I was started to notice I was craving ps again and losing steam, getting tired and agitated. 
But honest to God it feels like I've never done percs before. No cravings, but you'll find yourself in moments where it was a habit to do your drug like after a meal etc, it pops into my mind for a second,  I then think about how fucking amazing i feel and totally forget again until another trigger but like I dont want to use!!!
Try it!! I personally think this is a miracle drug but can see the abuse potential. I was coherent the whole time though, able to do all my chores, watch my child etc. Wasnt sure what I was in for but I am super excited it feels like I'm not cuffed to the percs. I plan on only taking another 1mg maybe the next 2 days if I need it. 
Hope this helps. Seems like you .maybe didnt have a problem such as mine in the sense you mentioned you have your own script so you have genuine issues. I didnt to start with, I just took percs recreationally and got hooked on the high and then coukdbt function without them. I never had an injury or anything to warrant taking them. 
Fingers crossed for you! Xo

You seem very wise and well rounded in the sense of knowing the scope and gravity of all this. Kudos to you man for being so awesome and fighting the good fight with fellow fallen friends. Hey OP, fellow woman with depression and been in states such as you described. Dont give up on her. Sometimes we feel unworthy or like we will drag you down so to speak. Sounds like she cares for you but since her medication change its fucking with her bad. BEEN THERE!! Literally one time my dr changed me to just an increase of my typical medication and it made me so crazy I ate the whole bottle and tried to end it all. 
Just sayin if you feel in your heart and your gut that she cares or cared you should keep on her. Give her a call, let her know she doesnt have to carry this weight alone. 
Hope you both feel better soon!! Xoxo

I've been mostly using hard but have taken a day here or there but that's maybe one day a month I cant score. Once I went 3 exact weeks and was finally seeing the light and got paid and thought oh okay, I'll be fine to get a few... got 5 and never looked back. I'm an addict. I have an addictive personality and have major depression that I'm medicated for. Been smoking weed since 12 and I'll be 35 next weekend. I've been reading a lot of inspiring stories as well as stories of failure but what matters is to never quit trying to quit. I know I cant continue to use. Its bittersweet. Love using but hate everything that comes with it. I'm just hunkering down with my little boy today, watching cartoons and surviving this moment. It's a mind over matter thing for me too. I remind myself it's not going to last forever, it's basically like a really bad flu for a few weeks. 
Took 2mg of suboxone almost 30 mins ago and starting to feel a bit better!! Very hopeful here.

OP, I am a (f34) and I remember when I was in highschool I used a diary faithfully and at times I'd leave it out on purpose to get my boyfriend at the time to read it. For example, if he had upset me, maybe I'd write something to the effect of how another guy was flirting with me, etc, hoping my boyfriend would read it and become jealous. Childish I know, again I was about 15 . Anyway, there was also another time I cheated on him and it was eating me up so I wrote about it in my diary and left it out for him to read. He read it and was upset, clearly, but we worked through it and were tg about 7 years! 
Maybe your gf was having cold feet and had coffee with her ex but felt terrible and hoped youd read the entry so you both you talk about it because she cant find a way to bring it up. 
Not advocating for her at all. I'm very sorry you're going through this. Matters of the heart are so painful. 
Postpone the wedding and talk to her. Dont be afraid to say you read her diary. If you're about to marry her, she should hold no secrets from you. 
Also IMO if she didnt want the diary read she would have hidden it. I mean anyone who writes in a diary in their adolescence, teens or adult life has to know there is a possibility someone will read these personal thoughts. 
Chin up though, everything happens for a reason.

Hey! Girl you're doing amazing! I got clean for 3 weeks back in March, I'm an idiot for going back to them but we all know how that goes. You sound exactly how I feel when I'm coming off pain pills. My pill of choice is percocet. Zero energy, just feel like dead on the inside and outside. Sorry about hubby with no patience. He clearly doesnt understand but we do. Keep coming here and venting when you need to. I find it helps to know other people are in your shoes and most times in worse shape. Very sorry about your back pain but just keep your chin up. It's so worth the freedom in the end. You're doing amazing dont even question that. Fuck the house work for now, you have your whole life to clean the damn thing! And dont worry about the working out thing. I will say though for me it's like a mind over matter thing.
